# TurboTax

> TurboTax by Intuit provides online tax preparation software and connects taxpayers with local tax experts for full-service tax filing assistance.

TurboTax offers both DIY tax software and expert-assisted tax preparation services through a nationwide network of certified tax professionals. The platform specializes in handling various tax situations including self-employment, retirement income, child tax credits, and itemized deductions.

## Key Topics

- TurboTax

- Retirement Income
